sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-10-28 17:36 UTC; scope: Daily; date range: 2026-10-28 through 2026-10-28; ranking basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains, with a GitHub Search fresh-repository addendum.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Coding-agent design and workflow tools dominate the daily signal, while LinkSwift leads all listed repos with +3,209 stars today and DeepTutor follows at +2,376. A newly created pose-gallery repo also surfaced in the last-two-days search, but is kept separate from the Trending star-gain ranking.

sections.title: Top Repositories
sections.content:
1. **[hmjz100/LinkSwift](https://github.com/hmjz100/LinkSwift) - A JavaScript userscript that extracts direct-download links from major Chinese cloud-drive services.**

  **Language:** JavaScript | **Stars gained in window:** +3,209 | **Total stars:** 34,100 | **Why notable:** The strongest daily star-gain signal (+3,209) and a high-utility browser userscript spanning multiple cloud-drive providers.

2. **[HKUDS/DeepTutor](https://github.com/HKUDS/DeepTutor) - A lifelong personalized tutoring application with learning workflows and a dedicated workspace.**

  **Language:** Python | **Stars gained in window:** +2,376 | **Total stars:** 47,665 | **Why notable:** Second-highest daily gain (+2,376); its Oct. 28 v1.7.0 release expands the learning workspace, modular install, notebooks, and lesson narration.

3. **[Nutlope/hallmark](https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark) - A design skill for coding agents that aims to avoid generic, AI-generated frontend aesthetics.**

  **Language:** CSS | **Stars gained in window:** +2,109 | **Total stars:** 40,368 | **Why notable:** Third-highest daily gain (+2,109); distinguishes itself with a 50-theme design catalog and browser-based review gates.

4. **[pbakaus/impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable) - Design guidance for AI coding agents, including 24 commands and deterministic frontend checks.**

  **Language:** Rust | **Stars gained in window:** +1,471 | **Total stars:** 92,151 | **Why notable:** Strong daily momentum (+1,471) in the same design-quality cluster, with a CLI and 62 deterministic detector rules.

5. **[elayadesign/ai-design-skills](https://github.com/elayadesign/ai-design-skills) - A collection of installable design skills for AI coding tools; its README currently lists a landing-page design skill.**

  **Language:** N/A - not available from GitHub | **Stars gained in window:** +1,395 | **Total stars:** 10,883 | **Why notable:** Shows demand for portable, markdown-based design workflows that can be installed across coding assistants.

6. **[obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) - An agentic skills framework and software-development methodology for coding agents.**

  **Language:** Shell | **Stars gained in window:** +1,096 | **Total stars:** 307,229 | **Why notable:** Still pulls +1,096 stars in a day at a very large installed base; its spec-to-plan, TDD, and subagent workflow is a leading agent-methodology example.

7. **[JetBrains/thinkrail](https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail) - A lightweight IDE for vibe-coding with pi that adapts to how the developer works.**

  **Language:** TypeScript | **Stars gained in window:** +1,075 | **Total stars:** 4,794 | **Why notable:** A major daily signal (+1,075) for the IDE/editor layer around coding agents rather than just another agent prompt pack.

8. **[nightly-labs/openbot](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot) - A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates, task queues, file sharing, and browser control.**

  **Language:** TypeScript | **Stars gained in window:** +1,053 | **Total stars:** 3,070 | **Why notable:** Its +1,053 daily stars underline interest in persistent, multi-agent workspaces with local-first control.

9. **[makecindy/cindy](https://github.com/makecindy/cindy) - An open-source AI agent positioned as ready to use out of the box.**

  **Language:** TypeScript | **Stars gained in window:** +740 | **Total stars:** 7,935 | **Why notable:** A broad agent product rather than a single-purpose skill, with +740 stars today.

10. **[ruvnet/RuView](https://github.com/ruvnet/RuView) - A project that uses commodity Wi-Fi signals for spatial, presence, and vital-sign sensing without video.**

  **Language:** Rust | **Stars gained in window:** +596 | **Total stars:** 100,786 | **Why notable:** An unusual counterpoint to agent-heavy trends: +596 stars for a non-camera sensing application.

11. **[expo/skills](https://github.com/expo/skills) - A collection of AI-agent skills for Expo projects and Expo Application Services.**

  **Language:** Shell | **Stars gained in window:** +212 | **Total stars:** 3,459 | **Why notable:** A framework-specific example of agent skills moving into established app-development ecosystems.

12. **[macro-inc/macro](https://github.com/macro-inc/macro) - A unified team workspace spanning email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM with shared AI memory.**

  **Language:** Rust | **Stars gained in window:** +106 | **Total stars:** 5,301 | **Why notable:** A lower-gain but useful counterpoint: AI is being embedded into the shared workspace and collaboration layer.

13. **[anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh](https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh) - A newly created Chinese-language static gallery for AI pose references, with search, filters, and multiple viewing angles.**

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
- **Cloud-drive download tooling:** LinkSwift leads the daily star-gain ranking with a multi-provider cloud-drive userscript (+3,209).
- **AI-assisted learning:** DeepTutor is the clearest learning-focused signal, pairing personalized tutoring with a workspace, notebooks, and narrated lessons.
- **Design quality for coding agents:** Hallmark, Impeccable, and AI Design Skills turn visual direction into reusable agent workflows; the first two add structured checks, catalogs, or browser review.
- **Portable agent skills and process:** Superpowers, AI Design Skills, and Expo Skills package repeatable workflows as skills/rules; Superpowers foregrounds planning, TDD, and subagents.
- **Persistent agent workspaces and IDEs:** Thinkrail, OpenBot, and Macro place agents inside adaptable IDE or team-workspace surfaces rather than treating them only as chat endpoints.
- **Packaged AI applications:** DeepTutor, Cindy, OpenBot, Macro, and Superpowers span tutoring, general agents, collaboration, and agent workflow products.
- **Non-camera sensing:** RuView is a notable non-agent outlier, proposing Wi-Fi-based spatial and presence sensing.
- **Visual-reference assets and galleries:** The newly created AI Pose Gallery repo packages localized visual-reference data and a static gallery; its bundled image rights require attention.
- **Languages:** TypeScript (3), Rust (3), Shell (2), Python (1), JavaScript (1), CSS (1), HTML (1), and N/A (1), counted across all 13 listed repositories.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s standout is the practical packaging of AI workflows: reusable coding-agent skills, design QA, and persistent agent workspaces are drawing strong attention, alongside a strong download-utility spike. DeepTutor and the newly created gallery show separate demand in learning and visual-reference products; the latter’s README flags image-rights constraints.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: GitHub Trending daily at https://github.com/trending?since=daily. Corroboration: GitHub REST API repository metadata and default-branch commit endpoints, plus GitHub Search for repositories created since 2026-10-26 with more than 100 stars; README files were checked for narration-priority projects and the fresh-repo addendum. Trending gains are the displayed daily values, not inferred from totals. The fresh-search repo has no comparable daily star-gain value. Obvious list/course entries were omitted; no prior-window evidence was used, so Notable Shifts is omitted.
